Context: D. Mileage Allowance for Journeys by Road :

8. Cancellation charges.For official journeys cancelled in public interest, cancellation and reservation charges are reimbursable and are to be claimed in the normal T.A. Bill form. GIO (7) (e), SR 34 and GIO (16), SR 4.
9. Service Tax and Education Cess.Element of Service Tax, Education Cess and other similar levies charged on travel by Air/ Road/ Rail / Steamer are reimbursable. - GIO (7) (i), SR 34.
